name: Study Pack
description: Flashcards, quizzes, and matching games generated from any source material.
briefPlaceholder: Paste or describe the material to study — notes, a chapter, vocabulary, key concepts...
promptScaffold:
This job produces a STUDY & QUIZ PACK exhibit from the source material in the brief.
- Include three modes: flashcards (flip to reveal, shuffle, mark known/unknown), a multiple-choice quiz with instant feedback and a final score, and a matching game where the material suits it.
- Derive every card and question strictly from the provided material — do not import outside facts unless the brief asks for them.
- Track progress locally within the session (score, cards mastered) and let the user restart any mode.
- Keep the tone friendly and encouraging; show explanations for wrong answers.

options.label: Document
options.prompt: The study material is this local file: {value} — read it and derive all cards and questions from it.

options.label: Pasted text
options.placeholder: Paste the notes, chapter, or vocabulary here...

options.label: Web page
options.prompt: The study material is at this URL: {value} — fetch it (e.g., with curl) and derive all cards and questions from it.
